crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in…
Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues…
and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn’t repent of their works.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken to Moses.
translations.bsb: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said to Moses.
translations.kjv: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.
translations.asv: And Jehovah hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them, as Jehovah had spoken unto Moses.
